description.text: The ninth XY set, released on 3 February 2016 with 123 cards: 122 and a secret Gyarados-EX. It centers on a Shiny Mega Gyarados-EX, with five more Pokémon BREAK, among them Greninja BREAK and Luxray BREAK, and 11 new Pokémon-EX including Mega Scizor-EX. Misty and Skyla returned as full-art Trainers.
